text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I stopped by the dance studio to pick up something I'd forgotten,
Tamamo Cross called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, ya got a sec?
If ya ain't busy, mind watchin' our practice?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We're helpin' out with a haunted house called "Mummy Hunt"
for the local community exchange event, y'see.
The four of us are in charge of prep.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's an attraction where the mummy hunter and guests
shoot down attackin' mummies with toy guns.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Since the mummies don't got no script,
we're practicin' ad-lib actin' right now!
One of them "etudes," they call it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We're about to act out the mummies, so
could you tell us your impressions, dear~?
The theme of our etude is "A Mummy's Lingering Regrets."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Much obliged! Alright, here goes!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooohhh~~... Treashuuure...
I won't... give up... the treashuuure...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Vooo~~... VOOO! It's festival time!
I'll drag you into the festival toooo...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
~... I wanted to take care of someone more~.
Won't someone let me pamper them~...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
My regret is... hunger.
I am starving... Therefore, I will attack and eat.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~... If you only eat that,
you won't get enough vegetables.
I'll make some side dishes for you~.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Creek...!
Please make rice and miso soup too.
And second helpings as well...!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'll make as much as you want♪
Eat until your tummy is nice and full, okay~?
I'm so happy I get to look after Oguri-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
All-you-can-eat of Creek's cooking............ Pure heaven.
...*drool*.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, yer regret just got resolved right there!!
Why the heck are the mummies gettin' all wholesome with each other?!
Attack the humans, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, my stomach is empty.
I can still eat more!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That ain't the point!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Cut, cut!
Tama, what're ya doin' playin' the straight man?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: S-Sorry. It just slipped out...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So, what'd ya think of our acting?
Don't hold back, lay it on us!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
See, that's no good!!
It's a haunted house, it ain't supposed to be funny!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sure, my snarkin' didn't help, but Oguri and Creek
were clownin' around way too much in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, I'm sorry...
I didn't mean to play the fool, though...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's what makes ya a natural airhead! Anyway,
we gotta do somethin' 'bout this super laid-back vibe.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ain't there gonna be a hunter during the real thing?
If the hunter tightens up the mood, won't it work out somehow?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: True that. So who's playin' the mummy hunter?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I am.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Say so earlier!
Why were ya joinin' in on mummy practice then?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
As a mummy hunter, I thought I should understand
how the mummies feel... Was I mistaken?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If ya sympathize with 'em, won't it be harder to shoot 'em down?
*sigh*... This is lookin' rough...
Let's take this back to the drawin' board for now.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And Oguri, you study up on the hunter role.
Go watch some hunter movies or somethin' and do some research.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see, understood.
Tama is as dependable as ever.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, figures... It was supposed to be horror,
but it turned completely into a comedy routine.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about focusing on the scare factor?
They say sound and touch can heighten fear, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Why don't we try experiencing some real fear ourselves?
Let's walk through the academy at night and search for scary ideas!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...N-Not a bad idea, but... heck no!!
Stayin' in the school buildin' after dark is bad news! Ain't it?!
choice_data_list: It'll be fine if I come with you.
It'll be fine if I come with you.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yeah, the school buildin' at night really is creepy...
Let's find somethin' usable quick and bounce.
Like, what about these footsteps here?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of footsteps~, did you know?
There's a rumor that if you run through the school at night,
a red light will chase after you~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why're ya bringin' that up now?!
That's got nothin' to do with our ideas!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my?
Do you... hear something?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...N-No... No, no, no way!
I don't hear a single thing!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
――A-A red light.
Is that what Creek was talking about?
...Red... pret... ty... Mar... ve... lous...☆

text_block_list.name: Tamamo & Inari
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
N-No good!! Kids're gonna cry at this!
We shouldn't make it too scary!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's best if folks of all ages can enjoy it!
Let's just go with a comedy haunted house! Alright?!
